areas.name: Walnut Creek
areas.blurb: Home base for Lift Pickleball. Most lessons happen here or close by, so it's easy to find court time that fits your schedule.

areas.name: Lafayette
areas.blurb: Just down Highway 24 from Walnut Creek — Lafayette players get the same coaching without a long drive.

areas.name: Orinda
areas.blurb: A short trip along Highway 24, Orinda is an easy add-on for a lesson or a weekend clinic.

areas.name: Danville
areas.blurb: Serving Danville and the surrounding Tri-Valley, with sessions scheduled at courts convenient to you.

areas.name: Alamo
areas.blurb: Nestled between Walnut Creek and Danville, Alamo sits right in the middle of Lift Pickleball's regular coaching area.

areas.name: Blackhawk
areas.blurb: A quick drive from Walnut Creek — lessons for Blackhawk residents can be scheduled at nearby public courts.

areas.name: Round Hill
areas.blurb: Round Hill players are close to the same courts used for Danville and Alamo lessons — easy to fit into a regular schedule.

areas.name: Rossmoor
areas.blurb: Right in Walnut Creek, Rossmoor is one of the closest communities to home base — convenient, low-hassle scheduling.

areas.name: Concord
areas.blurb: North of Walnut Creek along I-680, Concord is a regular stop on the East Bay coaching rotation.

areas.name: Pleasant Hill
areas.blurb: Sitting between Walnut Creek and Concord, Pleasant Hill is squarely on Lift Pickleball's regular route.
